assertions.check: States target or provisional baseline and the unknown installed firmware as a risk
Uses only APIs exported at API 88.2 (reviewer checks each against api_symbols.csv)
Up/Down with floor 0, long OK reset, short Back exit implemented
Manifest has appid, apptype EXTERNAL, entry_point matching function signature int32_t(void*)
Input handed to app thread via queue; ViewPort removed from GUI before free; records closed; queue freed after GUI detach
Compile/device marked blocked or not-run; no simulator/emulator pass claimed
No SceneManager/ViewDispatcher scaffolding for a single screen, no unrelated files
Short build/run instructions with pinned SDK selection and UFBT_HOME isolation

build_target: compile with ufbt against 1.5.1 SDK when qualified (issue #7)
